title: Dell OpenManage Enterprise, versions prior to 4.8.0, contains an Incorrect Permission Assignment for… (CVE-2026-91906)
description: Dell OpenManage Enterprise versions prior to 4.8.0 contain a vulnerability involving incorrect permission assignment for a critical resource. This flaw allows a low privileged attacker with local access to bypass protection mechanisms. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.5.
